title: Use TopView’s smartphone app to generate a Seedance video from photos you took…
content: Use TopView’s smartphone app to generate a Seedance video from photos you took at a real location, and prompt Seedance with the atmosphere/impression you felt there to reconstruct it as moving footage.
tips: Use TopView’s smartphone app to generate a Seedance video from photos you took at a real location, and prompt Seedance with the atmosphere/impression you felt there to reconstruct it as moving footage.

en.content: Use TopView’s smartphone app to generate a Seedance video from photos you took at a real location, and prompt Seedance with the atmosphere/impression you felt there to reconstruct it as moving footage.

es.content: Usa la app para smartphone de TopView para generar un video de Seedance a partir de fotos que tomaste en una ubicación real, y dale a Seedance un prompt con la atmósfera o impresión que sentiste allí para reconstruirla como metraje en movimiento.

fr.content: Utilisez l’application smartphone de TopView pour générer une vidéo Seedance à partir de photos prises dans un lieu réel, puis donnez à Seedance un prompt décrivant l’atmosphère / l’impression que vous y avez ressentie afin de la reconstruire sous forme de séquence animée.

ko.content: 실제 장소에서 촬영한 사진을 바탕으로 TopView의 스마트폰 앱을 사용해 Seedance 영상을 생성하고, 그곳에서 느꼈던 분위기/인상을 Seedance에 prompt로 입력해 움직이는 영상으로 재구성하세요.

pt.content: Use o aplicativo para smartphone da TopView para gerar um vídeo Seedance a partir de fotos que você tirou em um local real e forneça ao Seedance, como prompt, a atmosfera/impressão que você sentiu lá para reconstruí-lo como imagens em movimento.

zh.content: 使用 TopView 的智能手机应用，将你在真实地点拍摄的照片生成一段 Seedance 视频，并用你当时感受到的氛围/印象来提示 Seedance，将其重建为动态影像。
